mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year, the Federal Reserve's tightening response suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of high inflation periods, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts exceeding 2.0% over two months indicates weakening residential demand that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year period.
